title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi Box Office Collection Day 1
summary: Tollywood action drama Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi opened to a Day 1 India net of ₹3.40 Cr across 1,991 shows. Early reports show India gross at ₹3.88 Cr and overseas gross at ₹0.50 Cr, with worldwide gross around ₹4.38 Cr on opening day. Full run totals later reported India net ₹12.94 Cr and worldwide ₹16.5 Cr.
content:
Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi opened on 18 April 2025 and registered a Day 1 India net collection of ₹3.40 Cr across 1,991 shows.

Initial box office snapshots reported India gross collections at ₹3.88 Cr and India net at ₹3.40 Cr for Day 1. Overseas grosses were recorded at around ₹0.50 Cr, bringing the film's Day 1 worldwide gross close to ₹4.38 Cr.

The film is described as an action drama thriller directed by Pradeep Chilukuri and produced by Ashoka Creations and NTR Arts. The cast includes Kalyan Ram, Saiee Manjrekar, Arjun Rampal, Vijayashanti, and Sohail Khan in key roles.

Day-wise reporting in the Sacnilk compilation lists detailed daily net collection movements: Day 1 ₹3.4 Cr, Day 2 ₹1.95 Cr (-42.65%), Day 3 ₹2.1 Cr (+7.69%), and subsequent daily and weekly figures that cumulatively lead to larger totals. Week 1 is shown as ₹10.51 Cr, Week 2 ₹2.14 Cr, and smaller returns in later weeks, with a reported Total India Net of ₹12.94 Cr.

The aggregated numbers in the same report list India Net Collection ₹12.94 Cr, India Gross Collection ₹15.25 Cr, Overseas Collection ₹1.25 Cr, and Worldwide Collection ₹16.5 Cr. These totals differ from the isolated Day 1 snapshot and reflect the full reported run covered by the Sacnilk tracking pages.

State-wise Day 1 gross contributions were provided for key regions: Karnataka ₹0.25 Cr, Andhra Pradesh & Telangana ₹3.7 Cr, Tamil Nadu ₹0.03 Cr, Kerala ₹0 Cr, Rest of India ₹0.02 Cr, totaling roughly ₹4 Cr for Day 1 in the states listed. Early multi-region footfalls and occupancy details were noted as available behind subscription access on the reporting site.

Release date and exhibition details: the release date is listed as 18th April 2025. Screen counts and budget were not disclosed in the report (budget shown as approximately unknown). The Sacnilk page includes a disclaimer that box office data are compiled from various sources and may differ from producer figures.

Verdict and longer-term performance were marked as coming soon in the original report. The article also points readers to the broader site for box office records, all-time lists, OTT release updates, and other movie business headlines. For viewers and industry watchers, the Sacnilk report provides day-wise detail and state-wise breakdowns but cautions about possible variances against official numbers.
